company_name: Shandong Weigao Group Medical Polymer Company Limited

equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2026 interim consolidated balance sheet, 30 June 2026; charged once here, flows are consolidated

equity_bridge.item: Interest-bearing investments whose income is stripped from the flows
equity_bridge.note: Non-current time deposits RMB357.0m + current debt instruments at FVOCI RMB423.7m, 30 June 2026 (matching-asset rule for the RMB110.2m interest income deducted from owner FCF). Pledged/restricted deposits RMB425.7m excluded as restricted.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: revenue_5yr_cagr (2.9%), rounded; equity CAGR rejected as the anchor
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR (6.0%) exceeds revenue (2.9%) by >100% and EPS is NEGATIVE (-4.8% 5yr, -16.1% 3yr): book value is compounding only because ~40% of a shrinking profit is retained, while ROE has fallen from 12.4% (FY2022) to 6.7% (FY2025). The equity CAGR therefore overstates the business's growth and is not used. Owner-FCF 3yr CAGR (+16.6%) is off the FY2022 working-capital trough (FY2022 owner FCF RMB969m) and is not a trend; the 5yr owner-FCF CAGR is -1.75% vs reported FCF -0.6%, because SBC+interest income grew from RMB97m to RMB184m while cash flow shrank. Base growth is anchored to revenue (~3%, matching H1 FY2026's +3.1%), not to equity or EPS.
historical_growth.notes: CAGR windows: 5yr FY2020->FY2025, 3yr FY2022->FY2025. FY2020 and FY2022 are restated comparatives (parser note). Owner-FCF series: FY2020 1,675.7; FY2022 968.8; FY2025 1,533.8 (reported FCF less SBC less interest income). EPS 0.46 -> 0.36 (FY2020 -> FY2025).

scenario_narratives.base: Price-regulated consumables incumbent: revenue grows ~3% (overseas +10% on 27% of sales, domestic flat), ex-interest EBITDA margin steps down once more to 22% and then holds as mix shift (orthopaedics, blood management, exports) offsets continuing provincial VBP rounds. Capex ~6% ~ D&A ex-amortisation. The 603014 pharma-packaging swap is treated as value-neutral and not modelled; the consolidated perimeter is today's.
scenario_narratives.bull: Value-based tendering reform plus Argon turning profitable restores the ex-interest EBITDA margin to 26% by FY2030 with 6% growth in FY2027-29 from overseas localisation and platform asset injections.
scenario_narratives.bear: VBP compression continues unabated for three more years (margin to 18.5%), revenue flat, Argon stays loss-making, and the related-party restructuring either leaks value from minorities or fails. Weighted at 30% because the FY2023-H1 FY2026 trajectory IS this scenario so far.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Owner-FCF DCF in CNY, converted to HKD at spot. The business is a cash-generative, net-cash consumables incumbent whose pricing is set administratively; the model's job is to say what the flows are worth if margins stabilise at today's depressed level (base), recover partway (bull) or keep compressing (bear). The market prices the H-share at roughly 3x EV/EBITDA and ~8-9x trailing earnings, i.e. well inside even the bear case; the gap between the DCF and the price is the H-share/SOE-governance discount plus the market's belief that VBP compression has no floor. The DCF does not try to pay for a re-rating: the terminal value is capped at 12x owner FCF (~6x EBITDA), a multiple the stock itself has traded at within the last five years.
key_risks_to_valuation: VBP price compression continuing beyond FY2027 with no value-based offset (bear case); each 1pp of EBITDA margin is roughly RMB0.25/share
Weigao Blood Purification (603014.SH) share-for-asset swap: regulatory approval, terms and the post-deal consolidation perimeter are unknown; the model keeps today's perimeter
RMB/USD FX losses through Argon (RMB97m FY2025, RMB91m H1 FY2026) assumed to persist inside the margin; a reversal is upside
Hospital receivables lengthening: wc_capture of -15% on growth does not capture a level-shift in DSO; FY2025 conversion drag was ~RMB330m
H-share discount: the price may never converge to any DCF value while governance and capital-return policy are set by the parent group
CNY->HKD rate 1.1722 is dated 2026-10-11; refresh_price.py does not refresh fx_rate

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 2.92-5.92 HKD; CNYHKD=X 1.1722 same source (2026-10-11)
data_sources.financials: 1066.HK_Metrics.csv (core_metrics, CNY millions) FY2018-FY2025 plus H1 FY2024-H1 FY2026; FY2025 annual report (D&A split lines 7361-7363, lease payments 4913/7731, EPS note 8368-8380, share capital note 37); H1 FY2026 interim report (balance sheet 30 June 2026 lines 207-301, buyback disclosure 1177, treasury statement 2554)
data_sources.qualitative: 1066.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-12): segment mix, VBP, Argon, 603014 restructuring, analyst targets HK$4.00-4.80

inputs.share_count_basis: 4,570.63m H+domestic shares issued less ~60.1m held in treasury (31.06m repurchased FY2025 + 29.00m repurchased H1 FY2026, all held as treasury shares, not cancelled: FY2025 AR note 37, H1 FY2026 interim p.~1177/2554) plus ~3m dilutive incentive shares (FY2025 diluted-EPS note: 4,538.5m weighted diluted vs 4,535.4m basic). Cross-check: H1 FY2026 weighted-average basic count 4,523.8m. Held FLAT because SBC is fully expensed in the flows; buybacks (RMB159m FY2025, RMB108m H1 FY2026) are the cash mechanism funding that flat count.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report consolidated cash flow statement add-back, share-based payment expenses RMB73,969k (KPI StockBasedComp FY2025); equity-award cash taxes nil (net-share settlement withholding not used; awards settled from treasury/trust shares)
inputs.fx_note: Statements and all flows in RMB (CNY); HKEX H-share quote in HKD. CNY->HKD 1.1722 from Yahoo Finance CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-11T14:37Z. All per-share values are computed in CNY and converted at this rate; unsuffixed intrinsic_value/weighted_iv are in HKD (quote currency), CNY twins are suffixed. No dual listing exists for a parity check (1066.HK has no A-share line; the related 603014.SH is a different company), so the parity check is the H1 FY2026 buyback disclosure itself: HK$121.64m repurchase cost = RMB107.987m implies 1.1264 HKD/CNY in H1 2026 vs 1.1722 today, consistent direction (HKD per CNY > 1) and magnitude.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the currency of the flows: 10-year China Government Bond ~1.8%, China equity risk premium ~6.5%, beta ~1.1 for an H-share medical-consumables manufacturer exposed to administrative price setting -> cost of equity ~9.0%. The group is net cash (RMB3.6bn) with gross borrowings of RMB3.8bn at ~5% pre-tax, so WACC ~= cost of equity; 9.0% used for every scenario. VBP, FX, related-party and governance risk are charged ONCE, in the scenario flows and weights, not as a WACC premium.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B): leases as operating cost. The full FY2025 lease payment (principal RMB88.6m in financing + interest RMB19.5m, FY2025 AR lines 4913/7731) = RMB108.1m = 0.81% of revenue is charged inside adjusted EBITDA via lease_cost_pct_path; lease liabilities (RMB280.7m at 2026-06-30) are EXCLUDED from total_debt, which is bank borrowings only (1,244.4 current + 2,549.1 non-current). D&A used for cash-tax EBIT is ex right-of-use depreciation: FY2025 amortisation 286.7 + PP&E depreciation 614.0 = 900.7 (6.7% of revenue); ROU depreciation 81.0 excluded so the lease is not charged twice.
inputs.nci_treatment: Consolidated flows; non-controlling interests deducted ONCE in the equity bridge at book (RMB1,776.6m at 2026-06-30, H1 FY2026 interim line 287). NCI share of FY2025 profit was RMB98.5m (~5.8% of profit after tax); book NCI (~18x that share) is the more conservative of book vs capitalised-share deductions.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (operating company, non-US; routed via dcf-methods SKILL.md row 2 with the adaptations file applied: dual currency, leases, NCI, matching-asset rule). FY0 = FY2025 (Dec year-end); year 1 = FY2026, for which H1 is published (+3.1% revenue, -23% attributable profit, OCF +22%). EBITDA basis: the metrics EBITDA equals PBT + finance costs + D&A, so it INCLUDES interest income (RMB110.2m) and the FX loss (RMB96.6m FY2025, RMB91.4m H1 FY2026); the margin paths below are ex interest income (FY2025 ex-interest EBITDA margin 23.6%) and keep the FX loss inside the margin as a recurring cost of running Argon in USD. Interest income is stripped from the base and its source assets are in the bridge: bank cash is in net_debt, and the non-cash interest-bearing holdings (non-current time deposits RMB357.0m + current debt instruments at FVOCI RMB423.7m, 2026-06-30) are an equity_bridge item. Pledged/restricted deposits (RMB425.7m), loan receivables (RMB467.7m, largely related-party), interests in JVs (RMB322.5m) and the Songyuan fund stake are NOT added: either restricted, or their income stays inside EBITDA (JV share of results sits in PBT). Working capital: manufacturer/distributor with receivables + inventory > payables and lengthening hospital receivables (FY2025 OCF conversion drag ~RMB330m), so wc_capture is NEGATIVE (-15% of the revenue change). PENDING RESTRUCTURING NOT MODELLED: Weigao Blood Purification (603014.SH) is acquiring WEGO Prefills (the pharma-packaging subsidiary, 17% of revenue / 45% of segment profit, ~94% owned by this company) for RMB8.51bn in 603014 shares, approved by EGM Feb-2026 but subject to SSE/CSRC approval. On completion this company would swap a consolidated subsidiary for a large (likely controlling) stake in 603014; the valuation keeps today's consolidated perimeter. The deal is a swap at appraised values with 2026-28 profit guarantees (RMB640m/720m/784m) and is treated as roughly value-neutral per share; it is the main driver of the bull/bear spread via mix and governance, not a separate bridge item. FY2020 and FY2022 metrics rows are the restated comparatives from the following year's annual report (parser note), so the 5-year and 3-year CAGRs are on restated bases; the restatements are small relative to the trends they measure.

historical_owner_fcf_series.note: owner FCF = reported FCF - SBC - interest income, CNY millions, before the lease charge (which is applied in the forward build via lease_cost_pct_path)

bear.narrative: VBP keeps rolling province-by-province through generic consumables, orthopaedics and prefilled syringes with no value-based relief; domestic hospital volumes stay soft and receivables keep lengthening; Argon stays loss-making on US tariffs and FX; the 603014 related-party swap completes on terms that move the highest-margin segment (45% of segment profit) partly out of minority holders' reach, or fails after a prolonged SSE process and leaves management distracted. Revenue flat FY2027-28, ex-interest EBITDA margin compresses to 18.5% by FY2029 (H1 FY2026 trajectory continued for three more years) with capex held at 6.5% to defend tenders through automation; owner-FCF margin ~8-9%.

base.narrative: Revenue +3% (H1 FY2026 ran +3.1%: overseas ~+10% on 27% of sales, domestic flat), easing to 2.5%. Ex-interest EBITDA margin steps down from 23.6% (FY2025) to 22.5% in FY2026 as the sixth national VBP round and flush-syringe repricing land, then holds at 22% as orthopaedics/blood-management/overseas mix offsets further provincial VBP rounds; no recovery to the 2022 peak (32%) is assumed. Capex 6.5% in FY2026 (RMB600m of guided new lines plus maintenance) fading to 6%, slightly below D&A because RMB287m/yr of acquired-intangible amortisation is not replaced by capex. Cash tax 18% (FY2024-25 cash tax / PBT 19.5-19.9%, P&L rate 15-16%). Terminal cap 12x FCF (~6x EBITDA) for a structurally low-growth, price-regulated business.

bull.narrative: The July-2026 procurement notice's shift from lowest-price to value/life-cycle-cost tendering stops the margin bleed by FY2027; Argon's thrombectomy launch turns the interventional segment profitable; overseas (Indonesia JV template) grows low-teens and reaches ~35% of sales; the 603014 transaction completes on the guaranteed-profit terms and the platform receives further group asset injections. Growth 6% FY2027-29 then fading; ex-interest EBITDA margin recovers to 26% (the FY2023-24 range of 27-29% less interest income), still well below the 2022 peak.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 12x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 30%: attributable profit has fallen for three consecutive years (RMB2.76bn FY2022 -> RMB1.61bn FY2025 -> -23% in H1 FY2026) under a single administrative price-setter (VBP), and the pending 603014 related-party swap moves the most profitable segment inside a transaction minorities do not control. Bull cut to 20% because it needs three independent things to go right (procurement reform, Argon profitability, deal completion on guaranteed terms). Base 50%.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
